subject.title: fix(chat): preserve PNG attachments in native clients

question: Should native clients preserve every selected PNG, preserve only alpha-bearing PNGs, or continue normalizing all uploaded images to JPEG?
rationale: Current main intentionally normalizes these inputs to JPEG, while this PR broadens preservation to every PNG; tests can validate implementation mechanics but cannot choose the permanent fidelity-versus-size policy.

options.title: Preserve alpha PNGs
options.body: Preserve PNG when transparency would otherwise be lost, while keeping opaque PNGs on the established bounded JPEG path.

options.title: Preserve every PNG
options.body: Keep the PR's format-stability policy and accept more aggressive dimensional downscaling for lossless high-entropy inputs under fixed transport limits.

options.title: Keep JPEG normalization
options.body: Retain current native behavior and close this PR unless a narrower demonstrated fidelity requirement is approved.

recommendation.title: Preserve alpha PNGs
recommendation.body: Preserve PNG when transparency would otherwise be lost, while keeping opaque PNGs on the established bounded JPEG path.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-platform native product-policy choice, and the current PR timeline identifies this person as an ownership contact for the requested decision.
